SELECT i.invoice_id, i.invoice_code, i.shop_id, s.shop_name, p.full_name AS staff_name, st.table_number, i.total_amount, i.created_at, id.invoice_detail_id, id.drink_detail_id, dd.drink_id, d.drink_name, dd.size, id.quantity, id.unit_price, (id.unit_price * id.quantity) AS item_total, id.note FROM invoices i JOIN shops s ON i.shop_id = s.shop_id LEFT JOIN profiles p ON i.profile_id = p.profile_id LEFT JOIN shop_tables st ON st.table_id = i.table_id
LEFT JOIN invoice_details id ON i.invoice_id = id.invoice_id AND id.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN drink_details dd ON id.drink_detail_id = dd.drink_detail_id LEFT JOIN drinks d ON dd.drink_id = d.drink_id
ORDER BY , i.invoice_id, id.invoice_detail_id ASC
